rv.q: If you are willing to spend some time allowing its unusual structure and dynamics to seep into your soul, this is a play that will reward your efforts.
But he doesn’t give us a lot of help in determining what his play means, he presents many ideas in seven scenes performed by three actors.
But with so little narrative underpinning or character development, the effect is of three actors flailing desperately in the dark.

cn.t: Davis's meta-theatrical meditation on the state of theater divides critics: some find it bold and provocative, while others see it as puzzling and aimless despite its imaginative premise.
